description: GovTech is the lead agency driving Singapore’s Smart Nation initiatives and public sector digital transformation. As the Centre of Excellence for Infocomm Technology and Smart Systems (ICT & SS), GovTech develops the Singapore Government’s capabilities in Data Science & Artificial Intelligence, Application Development, Smart City Technology, Digital Infrastructure, and Cybersecurity. At GovTech, we offer you a purposeful career to make lives better where we empower our people to master their craft through robust learning and development opportunities all year round. Play a part in Singapore’s vision to build a Smart Nation and embark on your meaningful journey to build tech for public good. Join us to advance our mission and shape your future with us today! Learn more about GovTech at tech.gov.sg. [What you will be working on] Join GovTech’s Procurement team and become a procurement partner at the heart of Singapore's public sector digital transformation. This is not a traditional, back-office procurement role. You will work directly with the teams that are building and securing the nation's digital infrastructure, with a focus on our cybersecurity portfolio. You will manage the full procurement process for a variety of technology projects, ensuring the timely and compliant acquisition of the services and solutions needed to achieve our mission. Develop and execute data-driven procurement strategies, applying market intelligence and supply-chain insights to substantiate sourcing decisions for a wide range of technology solutions. Lead the tender and evaluation process in accordance with Government policies, collaborating with users to define robust requirements and ensure a fair and transparent evaluation. Manage supplier relationships and performance ensuring accountability to contractual obligations. Act as the primary point of contact for all procurement-related matters within your portfolio, managing communications with internal and external stakeholders. [What we are looking for] Tertiary education in a relevant discipline. A background in Computer Science, Engineering, Law, or Business is advantageous. Experience in public sector procurement is advantageous. Specific experience in procuring technology, or other complex services will be highly regarded. Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with an ability to work effectively with both technical and business teams. Good analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage processes and timelines effectively. A proactive, ownership-driven mindset. You must be a team player who is also capable of working independently to drive outcomes in a fast-paced environment. A genuine interest in technology and its application for the public good. What we offer you: GovTech is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive workplace that values diverse voices and perspectives, as we believe that diversity is the foundation to innovation. Our employee benefits are based on a total rewards approach, offering a holistic and market-competitive suite of perks. These include leave benefits to meet your work-life needs and employee wellness programs. We champion flexible work arrangements (subject to your job role) and trust that you will manage your own time to deliver your best, wherever you are, and whatever works best for you. Working at the intersection of engineering, policy, and sustainability, you will lead strategic bus procurement initiatives that directly influence fleet performance, passenger experience, and long-term asset resilience. Your work will take you beyond Singapore's borders as you scout emerging technologies and collaborate with global manufacturers to bring the most advanced solutions to our streets. As the Manager, Bus Procurement , you will drive diverse and impactful responsibilities encompassing comprehensive end-to-end bus procurement and strategic asset management, including: 1. Drive Fleet Renewal and Replacement : Lead the charge in developing and executing strategies to renew and replace fleet to meet operational, safety, and sustainability objectives across the public bus network. 2. Your work will directly support the advancement of Singapore's public bus fleet, enhance operational excellence and sustainability outcomes, and contribute to maintaining Singapore's position as a global leader in innovative and future-ready public transport solutions.

responsibilities: As Manager, Bus Procurement , you will play a key role in shaping Singapore's next-generation public bus fleet. By 2030, we will be replacing half of our 6,000-strong bus fleet with cutting-edge electric vehicles, and this role puts you in the forefront of this historic transition. Working at the intersection of engineering, policy, and sustainability, you will lead strategic bus procurement initiatives that directly influence fleet performance, passenger experience, and long-term asset resilience. Your work will take you beyond Singapore's borders as you scout emerging technologies and collaborate with global manufacturers to bring the most advanced solutions to our streets. You'll witness firsthand the latest innovations in electric propulsion, autonomous systems, and smart connectivity as you help modernise a fleet that's not just safe and reliable, but also future-ready. As the Manager, Bus Procurement , you will drive diverse and impactful responsibilities encompassing comprehensive end-to-end bus procurement and strategic asset management, including: 1. Drive Fleet Renewal and Replacement : Lead the charge in developing and executing strategies to renew and replace fleet to meet operational, safety, and sustainability objectives across the public bus network. 2. Tender Specifications & Evaluation : Lead in drafting new buses requirements, preparing tender specifications, and evaluating submissions to ensure the best value for the fleet. 3. Quality Assurance : Conduct pre-delivery inspections and testing of bus equipment to ensure they comply with contract specifications and operational standards. 4. Collaborate with Cross-Functional Teams : Coordinate with internal stakeholders (operations, engineering, policy, and system teams) to ensure seamless integration of bus systems and technologies onto the bus platform. 5. Partnership Management : Build and nurture strong relationships with overseas bus manufacturers and suppliers, staying informed on industry innovations and product developments. 6. Market Research & Design Specifications : Conduct in-depth research into emerging bus technologies and trends, making recommendations for design requirement to inform design improvements and future tender specifications. 7. Procurement Budget Oversight : Ensure cost-effective purchasing while maintaining high standards of quality, all within the boundaries of the procurement budget. Your work will directly support the advancement of Singapore's public bus fleet, enhance operational excellence and sustainability outcomes, and contribute to maintaining Singapore's position as a global leader in innovative and future-ready public transport solutions.
